data.question_intent: Inquire about customer behavior, forward indicators, and capital return strategy
data.question_quote: Have you seen any forward indicators around sentiment, any signs of de-risking or de-leveraging, any shift in particularly your corporate customers that might be on the receiving end of trade tariffs? Any insights there would be really helpful.
data.answer_quote: I think nothing that would really surprise you. Corporate customers, essentially, are in a wait-and-see mode, so some of the capex or large investments are on hold. Certainly, some of the shipments from China, specifically to the US, have slowed down, but we've seen no panic. So there's been no significant drawdowns. Deposit behaviour has remained normal, so nothing really to call out beyond the wait and see.
data.reason: The answer directly addresses the question about customer behavior, forward guidance, and capital return strategy, providing specific insights and maintaining narrative alignment with the question's intent.
